name: doggo
description: A pixel-art golden retriever buddy that reacts to your Claude Code session

display.title: Where the dog sits
display.description: band: above the prompt; pane: beside the transcript; off: hidden

name.title: Dog's name
name.description: What your golden retriever is called

barkAfterSeconds.title: Bark after (seconds)
barkAfterSeconds.description: Send a notification when a turn takes at least this long

breakAfterMinutes.title: Break reminder after (minutes)
breakAfterMinutes.description: How long a work streak runs before the dog brings its leash

spinner.title: Dog spinner
spinner.description: Replace Claude's spinner word with what the dog is doing

recap.title: Dog-speak recaps
recap.description: After a turn of 30s or more, ask Haiku for a one-line recap in dog voice (uses a few hundred tokens of your plan per turn)

barks.title: Bark sounds
barks.description: Play a bark when a long turn ends, on fetch and on treats (macOS)

outfits.title: Seasonal outfits
outfits.description: auto: dress up for Halloween, Christmas, New Year, Valentine's and the dog's birthday; off: never
